nodes.label: Continuous Native Generation Rule
nodes.rationale: If ios/ and android/ directories do not exist they are generated (Continuous Native Generation). Never create or edit them by hand — configure native behavior in app.json and config plugins. This avoids merge conflicts and keeps native code manageable via Expo tooling.

nodes.label: Auto-Clarity Safety Rule
nodes.rationale: Plain prose is used (then caveman resumes) for security warnings, irreversible actions, step sequences where fragments could scramble meaning, confused users, and anything persisted outside chat. Ensures safety and correctness override token savings.

nodes.label: Terse Response Principle
nodes.rationale: Every output token is billed and read (filler costs twice). Code, commands, paths, numbers, errors are payload — one changed character breaks them. Ceremony is expensive, grammar is cheap. A dropped negation costs more than every token saved, so clarity beats compression.

nodes.label: Non-Intimidating Billing UX Principle
nodes.rationale: Red color is only used for system errors and rejected payment proofs. Overdue bills use amber (not red) to avoid intimidating residents and maintain a trustworthy tone for a community billing app.

nodes.label: WCAG AA Color Contrast Compliance
nodes.rationale: v1.0.0 had multiple contrast failures (text.muted 2.56:1, status colors on tints as low as 2.0:1, neon lime dot at 1.3:1, icon colors below 3:1 WCAG 1.4.11). v2.0.0 corrects all with dedicated fg/solid/bg token triples and stricter placement rules.
